text: I'm really sorry to bother you this late and I'm probably being one of those over anxious mums but I can't settle so thought I'd message. My daughter Amira is 21 months and she's had a temperature since yesterday, it was 38.2 when I took it about twenty minutes ago under her arm. She's also got a really sore red nappy rash which I've been putting cream on, that's been going on a couple of days and I'm not too worried about that bit. The thing that's bothering me is her crying. It doesn't sound like her normal cry at all, it's thin and sort of high, almost like a squeak, and it just keeps going and going in this weak way, like she hasn't got the energy to really cry properly. And when I changed her just now her skin looked funny, kind of mottled and patchy on her legs and tummy, and her lips looked a bit pale, almost a bit bluish in the bathroom light, though maybe that's just the light? My partner says I'm overthinking it and she's just poorly with a temperature. I don't want to drag her out in the middle of the night for nothing but I also just have a feeling something isn't right. Is this something I should be worried about or am I being silly
